fixer.title: chat: preserve Markdown continuity across empty thinking

introducer.title: Implement Ctrl+F find widget support for chat panes and editors

cases.mechanism: Copying the accumulated sourceIndexes array for each merged fragment caused quadratic index copying and temporary allocations.
cases.symptom: Avoidable synchronous CPU and GC pressure on fragmented restored responses and inline-reference runs; established statically, without measured timings.
cases.fixedBehavior: Push source indices into function-local arrays, eliminating repeated growing-array copies while preserving source mappings.
cases.evidence: Base annotations.ts:94 spread the entire growing sourceIndexes array for every compatible Markdown merge. A run of n compatible restored fragments therefore copied n(n-1)/2 indices. The annotation function is synchronously called by chatListRenderer.ts:getNextProgressiveRenderContent and chatFindModel.ts:buildSegments. Added annotations.ts:89 uses push on the locally owned entry instead, and analogous merge branches are updated. blame_base_line resolved the old allocation to f5929d2a1e34b2dc062e80f9b14958d915928a44 at the same origin path.
